user.title: Connect to Matter Hub
user.description:
Enter the address of the Matter Hub web interface, such as {example_url}.

Matter Hub in Docker or on another computer listens on port 8482 unless you changed it. Use the address and port where its web interface is published.

The Matter Hub app (Stable, Alpha or Testing) can't be added yet: it only lets Home Assistant's Supervisor connect, and its port is assigned by the Supervisor. Matter Hub running in Docker or on another computer works.

A username and password are only needed when authentication is turned on in Matter Hub. Installing Matter Hub: {project_url}.

init.title: Enter the Matter Hub address
init.description:
Matter Bridge no longer reaches {title} through a Home Assistant ingress session, so the integration is not loaded. Ingress sessions belong to a logged-in user, and an integration cannot create one.

Enter the Matter Hub address to keep using this same integration. Its devices, entity names and automations stay.

Matter Hub in Docker or on another computer: use the address and port where its web interface is published, 8482 unless you changed it, such as {example_url}. The Matter Hub app (Stable, Alpha or Testing) can't be added yet: it only lets Home Assistant's Supervisor connect, and its port is assigned by the Supervisor. Matter Hub running in Docker or on another computer works.

Leave the username and password blank to keep ones already saved. Pairing codes are shown in the Matter Hub web interface, which the link on the service opens once this is running. See {project_url}.
